reviews.subtitle: Reviews from verified Airbnb guests, translated from Spanish.

carlosTulio.comment: The property is beautiful and the rooms comfortable, there is so much to do here. I wanted to stay longer.

anamaria.comment: Our stay at Hacienda El Recuerdo was wonderful. A very welcoming and peaceful place. You can truly connect with nature. Yesid and Marlen are very attentive and kind people who made us feel at home. Heinner is an excellent host. It was an excellent experience. The only thing to consider is how you get to the property, since it sits in the middle of the mountains. Overall, it is an unforgettable experience for those of us who love adventure and nature. We hope to return!

odessa.comment: I cannot say enough good things about this stay. Heinner was of great help even before we arrived, offering to guide us to the property from the city or arrange transport. His family lives here and they are all so kind and welcoming that we felt like we were visiting friends right away. Heinner is deeply involved in the local community and organised a tour so we could visit the local emerald mines! It was an incredible experience! We enjoyed walking the property, watching birds and even milking cows. All our meals were homemade by Heinner's mother and they were perfect. The wifi was fast and reliable and they have a great coworking space with desks.

sandraPatricia.comment: Our stay at Hacienda El Recuerdo was very pleasant. Our hosts Marlen, Yesid, Heinner, Kyra and Luna were very attentive, always looking after whatever we needed. The room was very comfortable and we slept wonderfully. The food was delicious and prepared with great love. We felt at home. Staying at El Recuerdo is a great option — it is not only about resting, but about getting to know the surroundings, doing ecotourism activities, meeting the locals, our roots, and appreciating the wonders of our country. We recommend it and we will return!

camilo.comment: Excellent experience, a very peaceful place with plenty of space for activities within the property. An exceptional connection with nature. Highly recommended.

faqs.title: Emerald Tourism in Colombia
faqs.description: We specialize in private tours in the Colombian Andes, with a special focus on emerald destinations, local mining heritage and community-led experiences.
faqs.enquiryDescription: Tell us your dates, group size and interests. Ask about destinations, guide languages and itinerary options before choosing your tour.

whatIsAndeanScapes.question: What is Andean Scapes?
whatIsAndeanScapes.answer: Andean Scapes creates private tours in Colombia’s Andes for local and international travelers, with a special focus on emerald tourism, mining heritage and local communities.

emeraldMineTour.question: What can I experience on an emerald tour in Colombia?
emeraldMineTour.answer: Emerald-focused itineraries can include guided mine visits, local mining stories and supervised, hands-on emerald searching. Activities vary by destination and plan; finding an emerald is possible but never guaranteed.

minerForADay.question: Can I be a miner for a day?
minerForADay.answer: Some itineraries offer a supervised, hands-on introduction to searching for emeralds with local guides. It is a visitor activity, not a mining job, and finding a stone is never guaranteed. Check each plan for its activities.

emeraldRegions.question: Where are Colombia’s emerald regions?
emeraldRegions.answer: Colombia’s best-known emerald regions include Muzo, Coscuez, Chivor and Gachalá. Each has its own mining history and landscape; private-tour destinations and dates depend on current availability.

privateTours.question: Do you offer private tours in the Colombian Andes?
privateTours.answer: Private, locally guided tours are our focus. We tailor the itinerary to your group, interests and dates, with a special focus on emerald tourism and the Andes’ cultural and natural heritage.

privateOrShared.question: Are your tours private or shared?
privateOrShared.answer: We focus on private tours tailored to your group. Availability, itinerary and inclusions depend on the destination and selected plan.

spanish.question: Do I need to speak Spanish?
spanish.answer: Guide languages vary by destination and itinerary. Check the tour details or ask us before booking so we can confirm the available language support.

afterReserve.question: What happens after I reserve?
afterReserve.answer: After reserving, the team confirms availability and shares the detailed itinerary, meeting point, preparation notes and any required coordination before the trip.

questionsFirst.question: Can I ask questions before paying?
questionsFirst.answer: Yes. Travelers can contact Andean Scapes before booking to confirm details, dates, transportation options, group size or special needs.

transportHelp.question: Can you help with transport?
transportHelp.answer: Transportation options may be available depending on the destination and package. Some experiences include transport, while others offer it as an add-on.

meals.question: Are meals included?
meals.answer: Many experiences include traditional Colombian meals, but inclusions depend on the selected package. Each experience page clearly shows what is included.

families.question: Are the experiences suitable for families?
families.answer: Some experiences are family-friendly, while others may require more walking, rural access or outdoor activity. The team can recommend the best option for your group.

bring.question: What should I bring?
bring.answer: Recommended items usually include comfortable clothes, walking shoes, a light jacket, sunscreen, water and personal essentials. Specific recommendations are shared before each experience.

payment.question: How does the deposit or payment work?
payment.answer: Some experiences may require a deposit to confirm the reservation, with the remaining balance paid according to the package conditions.

customized.question: Can experiences be customized?
customized.answer: In many cases, yes. The team can help adjust timing, transportation, lodging, meals or activities depending on availability and the type of experience.

localOrInternational.question: Is Andean Scapes only for international travelers?
localOrInternational.answer: No. Andean Scapes welcomes both Colombian and international travelers looking for authentic, local and well-organized experiences.
